title: 第21章 一招挫败龙凌云第22章 你釜底抽薪我顺手牵羊
slug: 被逐出宗门后师尊师姐后悔终生
content_zh:
“终于轮到我了！”
周通迫不及待一般，纵身跃上了擂台。
“见识到了我的实力，你非但没有逃跑，反而还要向我靠近吗？”
龙凌云有些惊讶道。
“不靠近的话，怎么能揍扁你呢？”
周通毫不客气的说道，顺手摄来了小妖女腰间的红尘剑。
“给这女人一点颜色瞧瞧，输了我可不饶你。”
小妖女挥舞着粉拳道。
“包赢的！”周通满脸轻松的回应。
“好大的口气，还真是有够自不量力的。”唐七直接嘲讽，“连我都不是她的对手，换做是你连一招都接不住！”
众人纷纷点头，表示认同。
不是觉得周通太弱，而是龙凌云太强了。
周通无视众人的想法，直直的盯着龙凌云的眼睛，感受到了一丝清澈的愚蠢。
“你识字吗？”
周通问道，却让龙凌云立刻恼羞成怒。
“别说这些没用的，我们是在比剑！”
看这副模样，周通心中已经有了答案，难怪龙凌云能掌握剑势，原来她拥有传说中的无字慧根！
持有此慧根者生来不识字，却能望形而知意，望万象而顿悟，望典籍而掌握精髓，堪称逆天。
剑圣那个老杂毛就是这种体质，没想到他的传人也是如此的。
“你在看什么，跟我比试还敢分神，真是好大的胆子！”

龙凌云出招了，只见她双目闪烁，无字慧根运转，打开了剑眼。
突然间，周通在她眼中变成了一堆死板的线条，看不出一丝剑气的流转。
“这…分明就是一个不懂剑的普通人，真是让我白期待了一场！”
龙凌云立刻意兴阑珊，就要随手结束这场战斗。
就在这时，周通拉开了起手式。
龙凌云立刻僵住了，脑海中似乎有万钧雷霆同时炸裂！
这是一种极端危险的信号，二话不说，她就准备运转剑势。
然而已经迟了，周通仿佛变成了一片深渊，架势不漏，毫无破绽！
龙凌云忍不住颤抖，浑身如同背负着万吨巨石，被更强的剑势完全压制！
“我竟然连反击都做不到！！”
她心中惊骇，直到现在才明白，周通哪里是不懂剑，分明是深不可测到了极点！
content_en:
"Finally it's my turn!"
Zhou Tong couldn't wait and jumped onto the ring.
"After seeing my strength, instead of running away, did you come closer to me?"
Long Lingyun was a little surprised.
"How can I beat you if I don't get close?"
Zhou Tong said unceremoniously, and took the Red Dust Sword from the little demon girl's waist.
"Show this woman some color, I won't let you go if you lose."
The little demon girl waved her pink fist.
"You're guaranteed to win!" Zhou Tong responded with a relaxed expression.
"Such a loud tone, you are really overestimating your capabilities." Tang Qi directly mocked, "Even I am not her opponent, but you can't even catch a single move!"
Everyone nodded in agreement.
It's not that Zhou Tong is too weak, but that Long Lingyun is too strong.
Zhou Tong ignored everyone's thoughts and stared straight into Long Lingyun's eyes, feeling a clear sense of stupidity.
"Are you literate?"
Zhou Tong asked, but Long Lingyun immediately became angry.
"Don't say these useless things, we are competing for swordsmanship!"
Looking at this look, Zhou Tong already had the answer in his mind. No wonder Long Lingyun could master the sword. It turned out that she had the legendary wordless wisdom root!
People with this wisdom root are born illiterate, but they can look at shapes and understand meanings, look at all phenomena and gain enlightenment, and look at classics and grasp the essence, which is incredible.
The old bastard Sword Master had this kind of physique, but he didn't expect that his successor would also be like this.
"What are you looking at? How dare you compete with me and get distracted? How brave you are!"
Long Lingyun made a move, and saw her eyes flickering, her wordless wisdom running, and she opened the sword eye.
Suddenly, Zhou Tong turned into a bunch of rigid lines in her eyes, with no trace of sword energy flowing.
"This... is clearly an ordinary person who doesn't know how to use swords. I really let my expectations go in vain!"
Long Lingyun immediately lost interest and wanted to end the battle casually.
At this moment, Zhou Tong opened his hand.
Long Lingyun froze immediately, as if thousands of thunderbolts exploded simultaneously in his mind!
This was an extremely dangerous signal. Without saying a word, she was ready to move her sword.
However, it was already too late, Zhou Tong seemed to have turned into an abyss, his posture was flawless and there was no flaw!
Long Lingyun couldn't help but tremble, his whole body felt like he was carrying tens of thousands of tons of boulders, and was completely suppressed by the stronger sword power!
"I can't even fight back!!"
She was horrified in her heart. Only now did she understand that Zhou Tong didn't understand swords. He was clearly unfathomable to the extreme!
